description.value:
Requirements Your drone or turret is in a space that includes a solid surface.

Your drone or turret plants itself on the ground, then extends retractable barriers that create a temporary wall. You either create a 5-foot-wide metal wall in a space adjacent to your drone or turret, or you extend a wall you've already created by an additional 5 feet, up to a maximum of 15 feet. The walls created by your exocortex are 1 inch thick, 5 feet high, and placed vertically on the border between squares. They must be placed on a solid horizontal surface. The walls are a part of your exocortex and use the the same statistics and Hit Points.

These walls automatically retract back into your exocortex if the drone or turret that created the walls moves (or is forced to move) from its location.
